data.description:
## Problem
`src/rebar/llm/code_review/detectors.py:196` and
`src/rebar/llm/code_review/bugfix_size_gate.py:413` hardcode a `severity` string
(`"critical"`, `"high"`) directly into a kernel-shaped finding without ever running through
`pass3_decide` (`review_kernel/decide.py`), so these DET-tier findings carry no computed
`validity`/`impact`/`priority`. The epic is migrating every consumer of `severity`
(aggregation ranking, the review-bot comment, the `fail_on_severity` workflow gate) onto
`priority` instead; DET-tier findings need a `priority` value before those consumers can
treat all findings uniformly.

## Approach
At each hardcode site, replace the `severity` key with a fixed `priority` float (keeping the
existing always-block semantics): the secrets detector's finding always blocks, so its
priority is pinned above every configured `block_threshold` (`priority: 1.0`); the
bugfix-size-gate's finding is a strong-but-not-maximal signal (`priority: 0.9`). Add a
`decision: "block"` key alongside at both sites so downstream consumers can rely on
`decision`/`priority` uniformly regardless of whether a finding came from the LLM kernel or a
DET-tier check.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `detectors.py`'s secrets-detector finding carries `priority: 1.0` and `decision: "block"`
  instead of `severity: "critical"`.
- [ ] `bugfix_size_gate.py`'s size-gate finding carries `priority: 0.9` and `decision: "block"`
  instead of `severity: "high"`.
- [ ] `pytest tests/unit/test_code_review_detectors.py` and the bugfix-size-gate test module
  (locate via `pytest --collect-only -q -k bugfix_size_gate`) pass, with assertions on the new
  `priority`/`decision` keys.
- [ ] `grep -rn '"severity"' src/rebar/llm/code_review/detectors.py src/rebar/llm/code_review/bugfix_size_gate.py`
  returns no matches.

## Testing
Tier: in-process unit test against the real detector/gate functions (pure calculation, no
I/O). Oracle: the returned finding dict's `priority` and `decision` keys, asserted by value.
Existing tests in `tests/unit/test_code_review_detectors.py` (and the size-gate's sibling
test file) are the RED oracle to strengthen.
data.title: Assign fixed priority to DET-tier findings (secrets detector, bugfix-size gate)
